text: おきるのが　はやくなる

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing' in English. おきるの = 'waking up'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く plus なる says something becomes that way. はやくなる = 'becomes quick'.
